age.evidence: Male Sprague-Dawley rats (226 -250 g upon arrival, Charles River, Portage, MI)

sex.evidence: Male Sprague-Dawley rats (226 -250 g upon arrival)

dosing.evidence: DOI (RBI-Sigma, Natick, MA) were dissolved in 0.9 % saline (SAL) and were microinjected... DOI at 0.0, 1.0, 5.0, and 25.0 μg/0.5 μl/side, ... bilateral microinjection (0.5 μl at 0.5 μl/min)

handling.evidence: rats were first handled and habituated to the custom-built two-compartment shuttle boxes (Med Associates, VT, USA) for 2 days (20 min/day)

group_housing.evidence: housed in pairs in transparent polycarbonate cages

day_night_flipped.evidence: maintained on a 12:12 light/dark schedule... All behavioral tests were conducted in the light cycle between 9:00 and 17:00

assays.assay_description: Two-compartment shuttle box (Med Associates). 30 trials/session during training and challenge tests, 20 trials/session for the acute drug tests in Exp 1. CS = 76 dB white noise (10 s); US = 0.8 mA footshock up to 5 s. Avoidance, escape, and intertrial crossings recorded. DOI microinfused into mPFC or NAs; CLZ given systemically.

application_type.evidence: Clozapine ... administrated subcutaneously at 10.0 mg/kg... DOI ... microinjected through ... injector (Plastics One), which extended ... below the tips of the guide cannulas in the NAs or mPFC

setup_habituation.evidence: rats were first handled and habituated to the custom-built two-compartment shuttle boxes ... for 2 days (20 min/day)

setup_restrain.evidence: rats were placed in the CAR boxes and tested for avoidance

food_restriction.evidence: Food and water were provided ad libitum [in home cage]; no food in apparatus during testing

water_restriction.evidence: Food and water were provided ad libitum [in home cage]; no water in apparatus during testing

time_to_assay.evidence: rats were injected with CLZ 10 mg/kg. Thirty minutes later, they were centrally infused ... tested for avoidance at 45 and 95 min after the CLZ injection

sample_size.evidence: Only those rats (119 out of 156) that reached the training criterion ... were used... n =6,8,8 for VEH; n =7, 8, 7 for CLZ

outcomes.summary: Intra-mPFC quinpirole dose-dependently potentiated CLZ's acute avoidance disruption while intra-mPFC DOI marginally reduced it; NAs infusions had no effect. Repeated CLZ produced tolerance (progressive recovery of avoidance), and intra-mPFC DOI (25 μg/side) abolished expression of CLZ tolerance whether given during induction (Exp 2) or immediately before the challenge test (Exp 3).
outcomes.statistics: Exp1 mPFC-DOI: main effect of DOI F(3,24)=3.156, p=0.043; DOI×time F(6,48)=2.340, p=0.046; marginal at 45 min F(3,24)=2.760, p=0.064. Exp2 challenge: CLZ F(1,38)=31.796, p<0.001; DOI F(2,38)=6.412, p=0.004; interaction F(2,38)=4.295, p=0.021. Exp3 challenge: F(2,21)=9.556, p=0.001; CLZ-DOI25 vs CLZ-SAL p=0.024.
outcomes.evidence: intra-mPFC infusion of DOI at 25.0 μg/0.5 μl/side during the induction period of CLZ tolerance completely abolished CLZ tolerance ... CLZ-DOI 25 group did not differ from the VEH-SAL group (p=0.344), but had significantly lower avoidance than the CLZ-SAL group (p=0.024)

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: tested at 45 and 95 min after the CLZ injection; these are separate test bouts with home-cage interval, not within-session time-course binning

B3_sequential_structure.evidence: no transition or sequence analysis reported

B4_ethological.evidence: measures are conditioned avoidance, escape, and intertrial crossings - not natural ethological behaviours

B5_social.evidence: rats tested individually in shuttle box

B6_cognitive.evidence: trained to acquire avoidance responding in 10 sessions; CS-US association is learned

B7_automated_classification.evidence: custom-built two-compartment shuttle boxes (Med Associates) - beam-break / standard operant recording

E1_environment_type.evidence: custom-built two-compartment shuttle boxes (Med Associates, VT, USA)

E2_shelter.evidence: shuttle box has no enclosed refuge

E3_bedding.evidence: footshock ... delivered to the metal grid floor

E7_social_context.evidence: rats tested individually in the shuttle box

E8_food_water.evidence: no food or water inside testing apparatus

D1_continuity.evidence: predrug day ... five drug test days ... retraining ... challenge test

D2_session_duration.evidence: 30 trials per session with CS 10 s, US up to 5 s, and intertrial interval 30-60 s; in Exp 1, 20 trials tested at 45 and 95 min after CLZ

D3_recording_days.evidence: 10 training sessions ... predrug retraining ... four 3-day cycles of drug testing (Exp 1) or five drug test days plus retraining and challenge (Exp 2/3)

D4_baseline.evidence: predrug retraining session ... predrug day avoidance data reported

D5_followup.evidence: One day after the 5th CLZ test, all rats were retrained drug-free ... then challenged with CLZ; challenge test occurs >24 h after last repeated dose

judge_notes: Merged gptoss's split of 'CAR' and 'Intertrial Crossing' into a single CAR assay - both are measured in the same apparatus during the same recording session and are sub-measures of one paradigm (per rubric: composite sub-scores count as separate measures within ONE assay).

Collapsed Exp 1, 2, and 3 into one CAR assay since they are the same behavioural paradigm under different drug/timing/route manipulations (rubric: same test under different drug doses/regimens = 1 assay).
B1 scored 1 (2-3 measures): avoidance, escape, intertrial crossing.

D2 scored 1 (15-60 min): 30 trials with 10 s CS + up to 5 s US + 30-60 s ITI per trial yields ~20-30 min per session; this is consistent across candidates that estimated it, though duration is not explicitly stated as a single number.
D3 scored 3 (15+): training (10 sessions) + predrug retraining + multiple drug test days + challenge clearly exceeds 15 recording days for this assay across the study.
Route set to 'other' for DOI dosing entry since central microinjection into mPFC/NAs (intraparenchymal) is not strictly i.c.v.; clarified in evidence.
Food/water restriction scored 'during' (default for standard short test, ad libitum in home cage).
